entities.name: Daraja Plains
entities.description: Calm region of Dominaria full of birds and griffins at the base of the Talruum Mountains, neutral zone between Zhalfir and Suq'Ata.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane where the Daraja Plains lay.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Region of Jamuraa phased out, later returned as its own plane.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker who phased out north-western Jamuraa to spare it from the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Destroyed the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: Invasion that Teferi wanted to spare the plains from.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which the plains returned to the multiverse.

events.summary: Teferi phases the Daraja Plains out with the rest of north-western Jamuraa to spare them from the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: since the planeswalker Teferi wanted to spare it from the horrors of the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria

events.summary: Jeska destroys the time rift and the plains are lost from Dominaria forever.
events.quote: They were forever lost from Dominaria when Jeska destroyed the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void.

events.summary: The plains return to the multiverse as part of the plane of Zhalfir.
events.quote: They now exist as part of the plane of Zhalfir.

relations.quote: They now exist as part of the plane of Zhalfir.
